name: Zhe Jiang Li Zi Yuan Food Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhe Jiang Li Zi Yuan Food Co.,Ltd. operates in China, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of a diverse range of beverages, notably including milk and other drink categories. The company offers an extensive product portfolio organized into six distinct series: milk beverages, dairy products, vegetable protein beverages, composite protein beverages, fruit juice beverages, and cereal-based drinks. Established in 1994, its main corporate office is situated in Jinhua, China.
